title: Women's Christmas Capybara – I'm Not Stuck, I'm Decorated Hoodie

seo.title: Christmas Capybara Hoodie: I'm Not Stuck, I'm Decorated
seo.description: A funny Christmas capybara hoodie for women: one calm capybara wrapped in string lights, I'M NOT STUCK. I'M DECORATED. Printed to order, free US shipping on $45+.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

This Christmas capybara hoodie is for the woman who has spent half of December untangling string lights and wants everyone to know she is not stuck, she is decorated.

One unbothered capybara sits completely wrapped in a tangle of colorful string lights with a red ornament balanced on its head. I'M NOT STUCK. runs above it in heavy red slab letters and I'M DECORATED. below in green.

Pull it on for tree-trimming night, the office party and every holiday movie marathon. The lights stay on and the capybara stays calm. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

How should I wear it?
Wear it as a cozy pullover for trimming the tree, a holiday movie night or Christmas morning. The Graphic Tees Co. print sits across the chest above the front pouch pocket, so the capybara and both lines read clearly from across the room, and the hood keeps it warm.

What colors does it come in?
The Women's Christmas Capybara hoodie comes in Sand and Navy. On Sand the lettering is deep red and forest green; on Navy the green is brightened so the I'M DECORATED. line stays easy to read, a small choice from Graphic Tees Co.

How does it fit?
It is a classic unisex cut in S through 3XL. Order your usual size, or go up one for a roomier fit over layers.
